lines.cap: This dog waited at the same train station every day. For nine years.
lines.say: This dog waited at the same train station every day. For nine years.

lines.cap: In 1924, a professor in Tokyo took in a puppy called Hachikō.
lines.say: In 1924, a professor in Tokyo took in a puppy called Hachikō.

lines.cap: Every evening, Hachi walked to Shibuya station to meet his train home.
lines.say: Every evening, Hachi walked to Shibuya station to meet his train home.

lines.cap: Then one day in 1925, the professor didn't come back. He had died at work.
lines.say: Then one day in 1925, the professor didn't come back. He had died at work.

lines.cap: Hachi came back the next evening. And the next. And the next.
lines.say: Hachi came back the next evening. And the next. And the next.

lines.cap: Through rain, snow and summer, for almost ten years, he never stopped coming.
lines.say: Through rain, snow and summer, for almost ten years, he never stopped coming.

lines.cap: Strangers started bringing him food. In 1934, they built him a statue, while he was still alive.
lines.say: Strangers started bringing him food. In 1934, they built him a statue, while he was still alive.

lines.cap: In 1935, Hachi died, still close to the station.
lines.say: In 1935, Hachi died, still close to the station.

lines.cap: His statue still stands at Shibuya. People still meet there, every single day.
lines.say: His statue still stands at Shibuya. People still meet there, every single day.
